content: After hackers stole a shocking $6.3 billion from Binance customers in a record-breaking crypto heist, the company’s CEO says that 90 percent of the funds have been replaced, and the company plans to cover the remaining 10 percent as well. Binance is covering the stolen funds directly, and the remaining 10 percent consists of “less liquid” tokens, which the company says may take longer to acquire. The company also said in a post on X that, while withdrawals remain paused, they’re on track to be enabled on Sunday. > Our commitment remains the same: Binance will fully cover the financial impact of the funds stolen in this incident. We will continue to demonstrate this commitment through measurable progress, transparent reporting, and concrete actions. > Our next milestone in focus is resuming the withdrawal services for users. We remain on track to reopen withdrawals within our previously stated timeframe (on Sunday, 2026-11-01) and will provide a further update as soon as details are confirmed. [Media: https://twitter.com/_RichardTeng/status/2116538946188726474]
chineseTitle: 币安首席执行官表示 90% 的被盗资产已被“补充”
chineseSummary: 黑客在一次破纪录的加密货币盗窃中从币安客户那里窃取了令人震惊的 63 亿美元后，该公司首席执行官表示 90% 的资金已被替换，并且该公司还计划弥补剩余的 10%。币安将直接弥补被盗资金，剩下的 10% 包括“更少的 [...]
chineseContent: 黑客在一次破纪录的加密货币盗窃中从币安客户那里窃取了令人震惊的 63 亿美元后，该公司首席执行官表示 90% 的资金已被替换，并且该公司还计划弥补剩余的 10%。币安将直接弥补被盗资金，其余 10% 是“流动性较差”的代币，该公司表示可能需要更长时间才能获得这些代币。该公司还在 X 上的一篇帖子中表示，虽然提款仍处于暂停状态，但有望在周日启用。 > 我们的承诺保持不变：币安将全额承担本次事件中被盗资金的财务影响。我们将继续通过可衡量的进展、透明的报告和具体行动来证明这一承诺。 > 我们重点关注的下一个里程碑是恢复用户的提现服务。我们仍将在之前规定的时间范围内（周日，2026 年 11 月 1 日）重新开放提款，并将在细节得到确认后立即提供进一步的更新。 [媒体：https://twitter.com/_RichardTeng/status/2116538946188726474]
